summary: Story 132.5 adds an opt-in readiness-only operator/dashboard split profile. Compose scope is limited to telegram-gateway and clawhip-daemon; console-cli remains host-side and dashboard/static remains a static browser asset boundary. No live ingress, runtime auth enforcement, host port, production credential, or production host mutation is introduced.

profile_artifact.activation_command_reference: OPERATOR_DASHBOARD_AUTH_TOKEN=<redacted> docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.operator-dashboard-split.yml --profile operator-dashboard-split config

default_preservation.required_statement: Without docker-compose.operator-dashboard-split.yml and --profile operator-dashboard-split, Telegram, console, dashboard static assets, registry, worker, and MCP defaults remain unchanged.

telegram_ingress.ingress_mode: internal compose network plus operator-managed tunnel or reverse proxy evidence only
telegram_ingress.runtime_auth_boundary_preserved: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TG_ALLOWLIST_USER_IDS remain the runtime Telegram auth boundary

console_boundary.not_compose_evidence: docker-compose.digest.yml states console-cli is not a compose service
console_boundary.runtime_auth_boundary_preserved: existing host-side actor identity, trace, idempotency, and approval controls remain authoritative
console_boundary.trace_ref: console trace command and existing caller trace/idempotency controls

dashboard_boundary.ingress_mode: future external operator proxy/tunnel readiness only; no live dashboard service is added
dashboard_boundary.runtime_auth_boundary_preserved: existing dashboard/API route-family boundaries remain unchanged; this story adds no in-process dashboard auth enforcement
dashboard_boundary.trace_ref: dashboard route families keep visible-selector/fail-closed browser contracts and add no hidden trace or credential side channels
dashboard_boundary.version_ref: dashboard/static/health-readiness.js renders health version; dashboard/static/replay-lifecycle-contract.json carries static contract version

preserved_boundaries: console host-side actor identity trace idempotency and approval controls
dashboard/API route-family auth and fail-closed boundaries
auth_policy.failure_policy: fail closed at compose interpolation for missing OPERATOR_DASHBOARD_AUTH_TOKEN; no production value is committed

health_readiness.telegram: GET /v1/health on telegram-gateway includes status service version
health_readiness.console: host-side console_cli import/version availability, not compose healthcheck
health_readiness.dashboard: static health-readiness.js plus approved /v1/health backend boundary; no live dashboard service health

trace_propagation.console: console trace command and caller trace/idempotency controls remain host-side
trace_propagation.dashboard: visible-selector/fail-closed dashboard contracts add no hidden trace or credential side channels

version_compatibility.compose_images: operator-facing compose services continue to use ${OMB_VERSION:-dev}
version_compatibility.console: console_cli.__version__; console-cli is excluded from digest compose because it is not a compose service
version_compatibility.dashboard: dashboard/static/health-readiness.js version rendering and replay-lifecycle-contract.json version

validates: operator/dashboard overlay is opt-in and compose-scoped to telegram-gateway and clawhip-daemon only
OPERATOR_DASHBOARD_AUTH_TOKEN is required as placeholder-only future ingress evidence
console-cli remains host-side and dashboard/static remains static future-ingress readiness only
Story 132.3 and 132.4 prerequisite artifacts remain present and done
Telegram/console/dashboard ingress auth health/readiness trace propagation and version compatibility evidence is explicit
secret hygiene covers dashboard/static browser payloads, Telegram/console code, docs, artifacts, and logs with no production secret values
no host ports, external hostname, reverse-proxy activation, live production activation, or runtime auth overclaim is present

non_goals: no production credentials or token values
no registry worker MCP or event-bus authority change
